title: デビュー戦の後に・賑々しく狂おしき

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, did you see Yaeno Muteki?! Her acceleration was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! She was astounding! I bet she's gonna steal the show at the Classics next year!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …So this is the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah…
choice_data_list: Yaeno? Are you okay?
Yaeno? Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki's expression is tight with exhaustion as she returns to the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She didn't seem particularly out of breath when she crossed the finish line, so what could've caused this?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm… ashamed of myself. I got swept up by the excitement on the track.
choice_data_list: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The feverish energy from the stands affected me a great deal…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: As a result, I had to expend far more energy than usual to keep my inner flame at bay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems the heated atmosphere fanned her competitive spirit and made it difficult to control, thus causing a greater strain on her mind.
choice_data_list: Make sure you rest up after getting home today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Right now, it's best to prioritize her recovery. I tell her to take it easy and that we'll have a meeting in place of training tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Understood. My apologies for my lack of control.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next morning, I take a stroll out to the riverside, wondering the whole way over if Yaeno Muteki has recovered yet.
Huff… Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While I'm partially surprised to see her, I also had a feeling she might be here. After all, I know just how disciplined and harsh she is on herself.
choice_data_list: Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh! Good morning, Trainer.
choice_data_list: How are you feeling? Not too sore?
How are you feeling? Not too sore?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. The burden on my mind has lifted as well. My thoughts are clear once more.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Allow me to demonstrate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It doesn't look like there's anything to worry about her physically, judging from how easily she's doing her squats, but…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can sense some impatience from her, just from the mere fact that she's doing regular exercises and not practicing her katas.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Phew.
choice_data_list: You seem agitated.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Nothing gets past you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My debut race yesterday… made me painfully aware of my own ineptitude.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My mental fortitude is still lacking if it can be so easily swayed by something like the crowd's enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm satisfied with my performance during the race. Thinking ahead, however…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm afraid I won't be able to fight on with how easily I stray from the path of blaze fierce, water still.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I must train both my mind and body even further!
choice_data_list: If that's the case, you should've just talked to me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No. This is a matter that concerns only me. I couldn't possibly bother you—
choice_data_list: I wouldn't think of it as a bother.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her that handling her intense competitive drive is a given, as I'm already well aware of it, and that I'm prepared to discuss and create a plan to help train her mental strength.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Have you lost your wits?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …My apologies. Nobody has ever said such a thing to me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ever since I was young, teachers and other adults alike gave up on me because they were so appalled by my unruly behavior.

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: I put up with it like you told me to! I held it in even when I was mad! But they wouldn't stop bugging me!

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: So I got angrier and angrier, and my head got all hot and—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Indeed, you did hold your feelings in. Next time, try to hold them in a little longer. Doing so will strengthen your patience.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: For that, you must train. Come, Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Despite my repeated failures, my grandfather accepted me for who I was.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And whenever I felt dejected, my grandmother would hold me close and cheer me on.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Though I have to say, I must have been a real handful.
choice_data_list: Well, I want to keep moving forward with you.
Well, I want to keep moving forward with you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Why would you go so far for me?
choice_data_list: Because I'm your trainer.
Because I'm your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I bear the weight of supporting Yaeno Muteki through three of the most important years in her life. I tell her I'll never be content with merely guiding her to victory.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …I see.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It seems that I was the one who had underestimated your duties as a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You seem ready to go through any lengths for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Then… would you be willing to bear the weight of my contrary nature, alongside everything else?
choice_data_list: That was always my intention.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …There's not a hint of hesitation in your eyes. Your words are not born simply from a sense of responsibility, but from the heart.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I shall put my faith in you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Allow me to renew my commitment to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I shall do my very best not to squander your good will.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I don't wish to impose the same burden on you that I did on my grandparents.
choice_data_list: You must be very grateful to them.
You must be very grateful to them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Very much so. The whole reason I want to do well in the Twinkle Series is so I can show them how much I've grown.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's not so much a repayment for their kindness, but… it's more like an expression of my gratitude for everything they've done for me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And to prove my growth, I must defeat mighty opponents while keeping my competitive impulses at bay.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I hope to face many a great adversary in the Twinkle Series.
choice_data_list: Does that mean…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. I wish to take on the Classic Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It is the tried-and-true path to greatness, so there's bound to be incredible contenders. I wish to train my mind and body through battle with them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But there is something I'm concerned about…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm unsure if I'll be able to maintain my form due to my inexperience with the Triple Crown races…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's right to be worried. The audience's energy at her debut race was nothing like that of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order for her to become acclimated to that energy and successfully maintain her form, she'll need to develop her race instincts…
choice_data_list: How about giving the Mainichi Hai a shot?
How about giving the Mainichi Hai a shot?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain that the skill level of those competing at the Mainichi Hai will make it a perfect prep race for the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Joining that race would still allow us ample time to deal with any issues which might arise… Very well. I have no objections.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let's take on the Mainichi Hai.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Now that I have a goal to work toward, I'm keener than ever to train!
